name: B10-0221/2026 (Renew) – Shortcomings and deficiencies of the ‘Amnesty Law’ in Venezuela
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on shortcomings and deficiencies of the ‘Amnesty Law’ in Venezuela
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion on Venezuela's Amnesty Law, which was meant to free political prisoners. The Parliament says the law is too limited, leaves many people detained, and keeps the courts and other institutions that carry out repression. It calls for all political prisoners to be freed immediately and without conditions, and for a peaceful, Venezuelan-led move to democracy.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. This is the Parliament's opinion and a set of demands, not a law.
- **Who it affects:** Venezuela's government, its courts and officials, and political prisoners held there.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to the Council, the Commission, the UN and others.
